info.title: Tollkit Chain
info.description: Wallet balances, tokens, transactions and prices on Base, Ethereum and Solana; crypto news, Hyperliquid perps, a market pulse and Chainlink price history. Other Tollkit tools are described at: https://extract.tollkit.dev/openapi.json, https://attest.tollkit.dev/openapi.json, https://web.tollkit.dev/openapi.json, https://data.tollkit.dev/openapi.json.
info.x-guidance: Call any operation with POST and the JSON body its schema shows. Without payment you get HTTP 402 with the exact price in USDC on Base or Solana; pay with any x402 client and repeat the request. Failed calls (any 4xx or 5xx) are never charged. Each operation's description says what it returns and which inputs are refused for free.

post.description: Wallet balance on Base, Ethereum or Solana: give an address, get its native ETH or SOL plus USDC (and USDT on Ethereum and Solana), and any other tokens you list (up to 20), with symbols and decimals applied. Read live from the chain. $0.002 per call; a bad address or an RPC failure is not charged.

post.description: Token price in USD from on-chain pools, on Base, Ethereum or Solana: give a token, get its current price from its deepest Uniswap v3 pool (Orca Whirlpool on Solana) against USDC or WETH/SOL, with the pool and its depth, and a flag when liquidity is thin. Read live from the chain, not a price API. $0.001 per call; a token with no pool is not charged.

token.description: ERC-20 contract or SPL mint to price.

pool_depth_usd.description: USD value of the quote token the pool holds: how much buying it could absorb.

low_liquidity.description: True under $10,000 of depth; treat the price as indicative.

post.description: Token check before you buy, send or accept a token, on Base, Ethereum or Solana: give a token address, get what it is (name, symbol, supply), its USD price and pool depth, and plain warnings read from the chain: thin or no liquidity; on Base and Ethereum who owns the contract and whether it is upgradeable or can mint, pause, blacklist or set fees; on Solana an active mint or freeze authority. Facts, not a rating. $0.004 per call; an address that isn't a token is not charged.

controls.description: Base/Ethereum only: owner, upgradeable proxy, and whether mint, pause, blacklist or fee-setting functions exist. Functions, not intent.

post.description: Check a token before you trade it, in one call, on Base, Ethereum or Solana: give a token address (and optionally your wallet and trade size in USD), get its USD price, pool depth, chain warnings (no pool, thin liquidity, mint or freeze authority), how big your trade is next to the pool, how much of the token your wallet already holds, and recent web results about it. Facts, not advice. $0.01 per call; an address that isn't a token is not charged.

wallet.description: Optional: your wallet, to see your current holding.

amount_usd.description: Optional: planned trade size in USD.

post.description: Crypto news for AI agents: give a coin or topic ("solana", "bitcoin ETF", "stablecoin rules"), get the latest news articles from the past hour, day or week with publisher, date, snippet and link, plus a short AI read of the coverage: its mood (positive, negative, mixed or neutral), a summary and the main themes, written only from those headlines. A read of the news, not advice. $0.004 per call; no news found is not charged.

query.description: Coin or topic, e.g. "solana" or "bitcoin ETF". Default: the crypto market.

post.description: Hyperliquid perpetuals market data for AI agents: give coins ("BTC", "ETH", "kPEPE") or nothing for the top markets, get mark and oracle price, 24h change, the current hourly funding rate and its annualized figure, open interest in coins and USD, 24h volume and max leverage. Sort by volume, open interest, funding or 24h move, and add up to a week of hourly funding history for one coin. $0.001 per call; an unknown coin is not charged.

coins.description: Hyperliquid coin names, e.g. ["BTC", "ETH"]. Leave out for the top markets.

funding_hours.description: Hourly funding history for this many hours; needs exactly one coin.

funding_hourly_pct.description: Current hourly funding rate in percent; positive means longs pay shorts.
